progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs3 and dwells most on E in Daramad. Chaharmezrab (0:25.2) introduces Db, centred on E. The line peaks at E4 (341.4 Hz) at 1:40.7. It closes on the tonic (Fs3 → A2 → Db4 → Fs3 → Fs3 → A2).
